title: Eliphaz Speaks: Accusations Against Job

questions.question: Who answers Job in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Job 22:1 (ESV): "Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:"

questions.question: Can a man be profitable to whom?
questions.explanation: Job 22:2 (ESV): "Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself."

questions.question: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty if you are what?
questions.explanation: Job 22:3 (ESV): "Is it any pleasure to the Almighty if you are righteous, or is it gain to him if you make your ways blameless?"

questions.question: Eliphaz accuses Job of sending whom away empty?
questions.explanation: Job 22:9 (ESV): "You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless were crushed."

questions.question: Possessing the land belongs to whom, according to Eliphaz?
questions.explanation: Job 22:8 (ESV): "The man of might possessed the land, and the man of rank lived in it."

questions.question: Is not God high in the what?
questions.explanation: Job 22:12 (ESV): "Is not God high in the heavens? See the highest stars, how lofty they are!"

questions.question: And you say, 'What does God know? Can he judge through the what?'
questions.explanation: Job 22:13 (ESV): "But you say, 'What does God know? Can he judge through the deep darkness?'"

questions.question: Will you keep to the old way that whom have trod?
questions.explanation: Job 22:15 (ESV): "Will you keep to the old way that wicked men have trod?"

questions.question: Agree with God, and be at what?
questions.explanation: Job 22:21 (ESV): "Agree with God, and be at peace; thereby good will come to you."

questions.question: Receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your what?
questions.explanation: Job 22:22 (ESV): "Receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart."

questions.question: If you lay gold in the what, then the Almighty will be your gold?
questions.explanation: Job 22:24–25 (ESV): "If you lay gold in the dust... then the Almighty will be your gold and your precious silver."

questions.question: You will decide on a matter, and it will be established for you, and light will shine on your what?
questions.explanation: Job 22:28 (ESV): "You will decide on a matter, and it will be established for you, and light will shine on your ways."

questions.question: For when they are humbled you say, 'It is because of what?'
questions.explanation: Job 22:29 (ESV): "For when they are humbled you say, 'It is because of pride'; but he saves the lowly."

questions.question: He delivers even the one who is not what?
questions.explanation: Job 22:30 (ESV): "He delivers even the one who is not innocent, who will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands."

questions.question: Eliphaz says Job has stripped the naked of their what?
questions.explanation: Job 22:6 (ESV): "For you have taken pledges of your brothers for nothing and stripped the naked of their clothing."

key_verse_text: Agree with God, and be at peace; thereby good will come to you.
